lines.speaker: plant_supervisor
lines.text: Twelve hour shifts, suit on, forty-one degrees in the hot aisle. You get used to the noise before you get used to the heat.

lines.speaker: plant_supervisor
lines.text: What's it doing? Allocation modelling, they say. Housing, work, medicine. Somebody has to decide who gets what and people are terrible at it.

lines.speaker: plant_supervisor
lines.text: It's better at it than we are. I've seen the outputs. That's not the part that bothers me.

choices.text: What's the part that bothers you?
Nothing is better at it than we are.

lines.speaker: plant_supervisor
lines.text: The clause went through with a name in it. Whoever did that, my shift lead has been reading the custody schedule out loud in the canteen all week.
